'''August 2001 Williston Park tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Grasshoppers Comics, Williston Park, NY on 18 August 2001. [[Billy Hauser]] won it. It is known from Chris Wodicka's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2865">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-19-williston-park-ny-8-18-01-epiosde-1d2865/ williston-park-ny-8-18-01-epiosde-1], DeckTech (Chris "Wedge231" Wodicka, 19 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-19-williston-park-ny-8-18-01-epiosde-1d2865/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 18 August 2001
* '''Site:''' Grasshoppers Comics, Williston Park, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Episode I Closed Environment]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Billy Hauser]]
